outside_course.reason: Unit 4 collection objectives use 1D and 2D arrays and ArrayList. AVL tree balancing requires a separate tree representation and rotations.

Unit 3 covers writing concrete Java classes and methods. The Abstract Classes is_a Classes tuple describes a subtype relationship, and abstract class design falls beyond those class-creation objectives.
CED 4.17.B traces binary search on an ordered collection. Binary search trees instead maintain ordering in linked tree nodes.
Unit 3 requires routine class design using fields, constructors, and methods. Named reusable object-oriented design patterns are outside that class-design scope.
Unit 4 traces traversal, search, sorting, and recursion on course collections. Dynamic programming adds caching and reuse of overlapping subproblems.
Generic type authoring and polymorphism-bound generics are outside AP CSA (4.8.A uses parameterized ArrayList<E> only).
Unit 4 traversal objectives use indexed data. Graph traversal requires following links between vertices.
Unit 4 uses 1D and 2D arrays and ArrayList. Vertex and edge structure is a separate data model.
Unit 4 specifies arrays and ArrayList as containers. Hash tables add key-based lookup and collision handling.
CED 1.12.A.2 explicitly excludes designing and implementing inheritance hierarchies from Fall 2025 AP CSA.

Unit 4 covers 1D and 2D arrays and ArrayList. Pointer-linked nodes and link traversal belong to a separate collection representation.
CED 2.6.B covers Java references and object equivalence. Explicit memory addresses and address arithmetic go beyond those references.
